summary: Aurora Mobile Limited furnished a Form 6-K on August 20, 2026, attaching Exhibit 99.1 with unaudited second quarter 2026 results; the US-equivalent disclosure is an earnings release on Form 8-K. Revenue rose 13% year over year to RMB101.2 million (US$14.9 million), gross profit RMB69.2 million, net income RMB2.1 million, adjusted EBITDA RMB3.8 million, with EngageLab ARR at US$14.6 million, up 170%. No special-situation terms, board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or transaction mechanics were stated. Routine quarterly results, not a deal event; watch guidance and cash generation rather than arbitrage.
